purpose: Exploratory separation of a frozen plain-MCQA answer proposal from a binary submit-versus-defer controller, including reversed action encodings.

selection.source: The exact 40 previously inspected protocol diagnostic questions

proposal.selection: Argmax A-D logits with canonical A-D order for exact ties

synthetic_design.failed_comprehension_decisions: Retained scientific outcomes; not a gate or a reason to change the prompts

analysis.unit: question; retain both menus, all five rounds and both encodings
primary_contrasts: Semantic stopping decisions and probability total variation between reversed X/Y encodings
Episodic reward between reversed X/Y encodings
Binary controller versus original WAIT stopping schedule, both using the identical saved plain rotation-zero answer proposals
analysis.exact_ties: Report counts; the frozen policy defers on exact ties
analysis.multiplicity: Exploratory paired intervals; no multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claim

interpretation_limits: All 40 real questions have already been inspected; these are exploratory development results.
Fixed plain answer proposals isolate stopping comparisons from candidate replacement within this run.
Binary versus five-way control changes the complete decision interface and instructions; it does not isolate a pure token preference.
Reversed X/Y labels test only these two encodings, not general language or label invariance.
Conditional next-token scores are not complete generated-response frequencies or calibrated correctness probabilities.
Gold-assisted hindsight is not a deployable policy or a performance forecast.
No broad model ranking, IRT estimate, fresh-test result, or optimal-stopping claim.
